process_fair_fre_data: process FAIR Fremont Campus hand-object interaction pickle data to kinematic qpos format
convert_to_object_frame: convert wrist poses and fingertip keypoints from world frame to object-relative coordinates
visualize_trajectory_in_mujoco: visualize processed hand-object trajectories in a MuJoCo passive viewer with optional video recording
export_trajectory_with_contact: export processed trajectory data including smoothed contact sequences as an NPZ file
convert_mesh_to_obj: convert raw object mesh files to OBJ format using pymeshlab for MuJoCo simulation
